title: 第1118章 万墟海域第1117章 启程中天
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
灵舟在云层中穿行了整整七天，精玄仙域中部的平原和丘陵渐渐被抛在身后，取而代之的是一片灰白色的荒芜地带。
付荣站在船头，看着前方的云层逐渐变得稀薄，露出一片看不到边际的海域。
海水的颜色不是常见的蓝或碧绿，而是一种浑浊的灰青色，海面上漂浮着大大小小的岛屿和礁石碎片。
他说：“前面是万墟海域。”
云昊走到船头，目光落在那片海域上：“万墟海域？”
付荣说：“精玄仙域通往中天仙域的必经之路之一。这片海域上古时是一片战场，打碎了无数仙山，留下了数不清的空间裂缝和残余禁制。
海域中的岛屿大多是残骸堆成的，地形复杂，不适合大批灵舟通过。但这里也是各路修士的汇集之地——从各仙域前往中天仙域的仙人，大多会从这里经过。”
顿了顿：“鱼龙混杂，什么人都有。”
雷虎从船舷边探出头，看着那片灰青色的海水：“俺看着不像海，像一锅馊汤。”
墨羽靠在船舷上，没有说话，但他的目光在警惕地扫视着下方海面上的岛屿。
付荣将灵舟降低了一些，贴着海面飞行，尽量避开那些不稳定的空间裂缝。
灵舟飞入万墟海域的范围后，空气中开始出现一种微弱的能量波动，像是有什么东西在虚空深处扰动。
飞了约莫半天，前方传来打斗的声音。
灵舟绕过一座巨大的礁石岛，看到一艘破损的商船卡在礁石间，船身倾斜，桅杆断裂，甲板上躺着几具尸体。
商船周围悬浮着十几道黑影，穿着黑色劲装，修为从太乙后期到太乙大圆满不等。
他们正在翻找商船上的货物，把仙晶和储物戒往口袋里塞。
领头的一个黑袍人，太乙大圆满巅峰，腰间挂着一柄弯刀，正在从一具尸体上扯下一枚储物戒。
其中一个黑影抬头看到了付荣的灵舟，一声尖锐的口哨声响起：“有肥羊！”
十几道黑影同时停下手中的动作，转头看向灵舟。
领头的黑袍人眯起眼睛打量着云昊一行四人，注意到付荣的气息内敛，看不透深浅，但云昊、墨羽和雷虎都收敛了气息，看起来只是三个普通的太乙境修士。

他咧嘴笑道：“四个过路的。老规矩，留下一半仙晶，放你们走。”
雷虎从船舷边站直了身体，目光落在那些黑袍人身上，转头看向云昊：“大哥，俺能动手不？”
云昊说：“留一个活口问话。”
雷虎咧嘴一笑，从灵舟上跳了下去。
落地时踩在一块礁石上，脚下的礁石四分五裂。
黑袍人首领看着雷虎，冷笑一声：“大罗初期？一个体修也敢这么嚣张？”
他挥了挥手，五个黑衣人从不同方向冲向雷虎，手中仙器亮起各色光芒。
雷虎没有躲，一拳砸向正面冲来的第一个黑衣人。
拳头与仙器碰撞，发出沉闷的碎裂声——那柄太乙后期的仙剑被一拳砸断，黑衣人被拳风轰飞出去，撞在商船的残骸上，滑落海中。
一拳一个，没有任何多余的动作，不到十息，五个黑衣人全部落海，有的昏迷，有的重伤。
黑袍人首领的脸色终于变了，他这才意识到自己看走了眼，大罗初期的体修和太乙大圆满之间的差距，比他想象中要大得多。
雷虎已经走回到了他面前，一拳砸向他的面门。
黑袍人首领拼尽全力举起弯刀格挡，弯刀碎裂，拳风震得他口吐鲜血，整个人倒飞出去，摔在商船的甲板上。
云昊从灵舟上落下来，走到黑袍人首领面前，目光平静地看着他：“你们是哪个势力的？”
黑袍人首领吐出一口血水，咬牙说：“万墟海域的虚空盗，不归任何势力管。你杀了老子，老子的兄弟会找你报仇。”
云昊问：“你们的老巢在哪？”
黑袍人首领冷笑：“你以为老子会说？”
云昊没有说话，转身走向商船残骸，检查了一下甲板上的尸体。
有老有少，有男有女，都是普通的商旅，太乙初期到太乙中期不等，没有大罗境的修士。
他们的储物戒已经被搜刮了大半，但有几枚被尸体压在身下，没有被发现。
content_en:
The spirit boat traveled through the clouds for seven days, and the plains and hills in the middle of the Jingxuan Immortal Territory were gradually left behind, replaced by a gray-white desolate area.
Fu Rong stood on the bow of the ship, watching the clouds in front of him gradually thinning, revealing a sea area with no visible edge.
The color of the sea water is not the usual blue or turquoise, but a turbid gray-green color, with large and small islands and reef fragments floating on the sea.
He said: "Ahead is the Wanxu Sea Area."
Yun Hao walked to the bow of the ship and his eyes fell on the sea area: "The Wanxu Sea Area?"
Fu Rong said: "One of the only roads from the Jingxuan Immortal Realm to the Zhongtian Immortal Realm. This sea area was a battlefield in ancient times, shattering countless fairy mountains, leaving countless space cracks and residual restrictions.
Most of the islands in the sea are made of debris, and the terrain is complex, making them unsuitable for large numbers of spirit boats to pass through. But this is also a gathering place for monks from all walks of life - most of the immortals who go to the Zhongtian Immortal Realm from various immortal realms will pass through here. "
After a pause: "It's a mixed bag, everyone is there."
Lei Hu stuck his head out from the side of the ship and looked at the gray-blue sea water: "I don't look like the sea, I look like a pot of sour soup."
Mo Yu leaned against the side of the ship and said nothing, but his eyes were scanning the islands on the sea below with vigilance.
Fu Rong lowered the spirit boat a little and flew close to the sea, trying to avoid those unstable space cracks.
After the spirit boat flew into the Wanxu Sea, a weak energy fluctuation began to appear in the air, as if something was disturbing deep in the void.
After flying for about a long time, the sound of fighting came from ahead.
The spirit boat went around a huge reef island and saw a damaged merchant ship stuck between the rocks. The hull was tilted, the mast was broken, and several bodies were lying on the deck.
There are more than a dozen black figures floating around the merchant ship, wearing black and powerful clothes. Their cultivation levels range from late Taiyi to Taiyi Dzogchen.
They were rummaging through the cargo on the merchant ship and stuffing fairy crystals and storage rings into their pockets.
The leader, a man in black robes, was at the peak of Taiyi Dzogchen. He had a scimitar hanging on his waist and was tearing off a storage ring from a corpse.
One of the dark figures looked up and saw Fu Rong's spirit boat, and a sharp whistle sounded: "There is a fat sheep!"
More than a dozen black figures stopped what they were doing at the same time and turned to look at the spirit boat.
The leading man in black robes squinted his eyes as he looked at Yun Hao and his group of four. He noticed that Fu Rong's aura was restrained and could not be seen through. However, Yun Hao, Mo Yu and Lei Hu all restrained their auras and looked like just three ordinary Taiyi realm monks.
He grinned and said: "Four passers-by. As per the old rules, leave half of the fairy crystal and let you go."
Lei Hu stood up straight from the side of the ship, his eyes fell on the men in black robes, and turned to look at Yun Hao: "Brother, can I do something?"
Yun Hao said: "Leave one alive for questioning."
Lei Hu grinned and jumped off the spirit boat.
When he landed, he stepped on a rock, and the rock beneath his feet fell into pieces.
The leader of the men in black robe looked at Lei Hu and sneered: "Early stage of Da Luo? How dare a body cultivator be so arrogant?"
He waved his hand, and five men in black rushed towards Thunder Tiger from different directions, the magical weapons in their hands lit up with various lights.
Lei Hu did not dodge and punched the first man in black who came forward.
The fist collided with the immortal weapon, making a dull cracking sound - the late Taiyi immortal sword was broken by a punch, and the man in black was blown away by the wind of the fist, hit the wreckage of the merchant ship, and fell into the sea.
One punch at a time, without any unnecessary movement, in less than ten breaths, all five men in black fell into the sea, some were unconscious, and some were seriously injured.
The expression of the leader of the black-robed men finally changed, and he realized that he had made a mistake. The gap between Da Luo's early physical cultivation and Taiyi's perfection was much greater than he thought.
Lei Hu had already walked back to him and punched him in the face.
The leader of the men in black robes tried his best to block with his scimitar, but the scimitar shattered and the wind of the fist shook his mouth.Vomiting blood, he flew out and fell on the deck of the merchant ship.
Yun Hao got off the spirit boat, walked to the leader of the black-robed men, and looked at him calmly: "Which force are you from?"
The leader of the black-robed man spit out a mouthful of blood and gritted his teeth and said: "The Void Pirates in the Wanxu Sea are not under the control of any force. If you kill me, my brothers will seek revenge on you."
Yun Hao asked: "Where is your home base?"
The leader of the men in black robes sneered: "Do you think I can say that?"
Yun Hao said nothing, turned around and walked towards the wreckage of the merchant ship, checking the bodies on the deck.
There were old and young, men and women, all ordinary business travelers, ranging from the early stage of Taiyi to the middle stage of Taiyi, and there were no monks in the Daluo realm.
Most of their storage rings have been plundered, but a few were buried under the corpses and were not found.
